name: Doctype resolves one row per doctype per language, none lost
note:
Guards the c_doctype_trl wiring. The cube CROSS JOINs the languages present in c_doctype_trl and LEFT JOINs the translation, so the count must equal the number of doctypes - not seven times it, and not less.

Both failure modes are real. Without the ad_language filter in the access_policy the cube returns a row per doctype PER LANGUAGE and multiplies any fact joined to it by seven. With a plain LEFT JOIN instead of the cross join, es_CO loses 7 of 1,343 doctypes, because that language is the only one with gaps in c_doctype_trl - the same silent row loss that cost 654 rows when a policy was added to Locator.

Measured identical at 239 across en_US, sk_SK, hu_HU and es_CO.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_doctype WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000036,0)
